      var trimmed = value.trim();
      return trimmed && trimmed.length <= limit && !/[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/.test(trimmed) ? trimmed : null;

        schema_version: 1,
        user_id: null,
        subscription_plan_name: null,

          })
        : [];
      candidates.sort(function (a, b) {
        var endA = timestamp(a.current_period_end);
        var endB = timestamp(b.current_period_end);
        if (endA !== endB) return endA > endB ? -1 : 1;
        var startA = timestamp(a.start_date);
        var startB = timestamp(b.start_date);
        if (startA !== startB) return startA > startB ? -1 : 1;
        var idA = text(a.id, 256) || '';
        var idB = text(b.id, 256) || '';

      return path
        .split('/')
        .map(function (segment) {

<script>
    // Language detection utilities
    const LanguageUtils = {
        isZhHans: (pathname) => {
            return pathname.includes('zh-hans') || 
                   pathname.includes('-zh-hans') ||
                   pathname === '/zh-hans' ||
                   pathname === '/zh-hans/';
        },
        
        isRoot: (pathname) => pathname === '/' || pathname === '',
        
        cleanPath: (pathname) => {
            return pathname.replace(/\/+/g, '/').replace(/\/$/, '') || '/';
        }
    };

    // URL transformation functions
    const UrlTransformers = {
        // Switch TO zh-hans
        toZhHans: (pathname) => {
            console.log("Switching TO zh-hans");
            
            if (LanguageUtils.isRoot(pathname)) {
                return '/zh-hans/';
            }
            
            // Tag pages
            if (pathname.startsWith('/tag/')) {
                const tagPaginationMatch = pathname.match(/^\/tag\/([^\/]+)\/page\/(\d+)\/?$/);
                if (tagPaginationMatch) {
                    const [, tagName, pageNum] = tagPaginationMatch;
                    return tagName.endsWith('-zh-hans') 
                        ? pathname 
                        : `/tag/${tagName}-zh-hans/page/${pageNum}/`;
                }
                
                const tagMatch = pathname.match(/^\/tag\/([^\/]+)\/?$/);
                if (tagMatch) {
                    const [, tagName] = tagMatch;
                    return tagName.endsWith('-zh-hans') 
                        ? pathname 
                        : `/tag/${tagName}-zh-hans/`;
                }
            }
            
            // Author pages
            if (pathname === '/author' || pathname === '/author/') {
                return '/author-zh-hans/';
            }
            
            if (pathname.startsWith('/author/')) {
                const authorPaginationMatch = pathname.match(/^\/author\/([^\/]+)\/page\/(\d+)\/?$/);
                if (authorPaginationMatch) {
                    const [, authorName, pageNum] = authorPaginationMatch;
                    return authorName.endsWith('-zh-hans')
                        ? pathname
                        : `/author/${authorName}-zh-hans/page/${pageNum}/`;
                }
                
                const authorMatch = pathname.match(/^\/author\/([^\/]+)\/?$/);
                if (authorMatch) {
                    const [, authorName] = authorMatch;
                    return authorName.endsWith('-zh-hans') 
                        ? pathname 
                        : `/author/${authorName}-zh-hans/`;
                }
            }
            
            // Regular pages with pagination
            const paginationMatch = pathname.match(/^\/([^\/]+)\/page\/(\d+)\/?$/);
            if (paginationMatch) {
                const [, slug, pageNum] = paginationMatch;
                return slug.endsWith('-zh-hans') 
                    ? pathname 
                    : `/${slug}-zh-hans/page/${pageNum}/`;
            }
            
            // Regular pages
            const slugMatch = pathname.match(/^\/([^\/]+)\/?$/);
            if (slugMatch) {
                const [, slug] = slugMatch;
                return slug.endsWith('-zh-hans') 
                    ? pathname 
                    : `/${slug}-zh-hans/`;
            }
            
            // Fallback
            return `/zh-hans${pathname}`;
        },
        
        // Switch FROM zh-hans (to default)
        fromZhHans: (pathname) => {
            console.log("Switching FROM zh-hans (to default)");
            
            if (pathname === '/zh-hans' || pathname === '/zh-hans/') {
                return '/';
            }
            
            // Author pages
            if (pathname === '/author-zh-hans' || pathname === '/author-zh-hans/') {
                return '/author/';
            }
            
            if (pathname.includes('/author/')) {
                const authorPaginationMatch = pathname.match(/^\/author\/([^\/]+)-zh-hans\/page\/(\d+)\/?$/);
                if (authorPaginationMatch) {
                    const [, authorName, pageNum] = authorPaginationMatch;
                    return `/author/${authorName}/page/${pageNum}/`;
                }
                
                const authorMatch = pathname.match(/^\/author\/([^\/]+)-zh-hans\/?$/);
                if (authorMatch) {
                    const [, authorName] = authorMatch;
                    return `/author/${authorName}/`;
                }
            }
            
            // Tag pages
            if (pathname.includes('/tag/')) {
                const tagPaginationMatch = pathname.match(/^\/tag\/([^\/]+)-zh-hans\/page\/(\d+)\/?$/);
                if (tagPaginationMatch) {
                    const [, tagName, pageNum] = tagPaginationMatch;
                    return `/tag/${tagName}/page/${pageNum}/`;
                }
                
                const tagMatch = pathname.match(/\/tag\/([^\/]+)-zh-hans\/?$/);
                if (tagMatch) {
                    const [, tagName] = tagMatch;
                    return `/tag/${tagName}/`;
                }
            }
            
            // Regular pages with pagination
            const paginationMatch = pathname.match(/^\/([^\/]+)-zh-hans\/page\/(\d+)\/?$/);
            if (paginationMatch) {
                const [, slug, pageNum] = paginationMatch;
                return `/${slug}/page/${pageNum}/`;
            }
            
            // Regular pages and cleanup
            let newPath = pathname.replace(/\/zh-hans(\/|$)/, '$1');
            newPath = newPath.replace(/-zh-hans(\/|$)/g, '$1');
            newPath = LanguageUtils.cleanPath(newPath);
            
            return newPath;
        }
    };

    // Main language switcher logic
    const languageSwitcher = document.getElementById('language-switcher');
    languageSwitcher.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const language = e.target.dataset.language;
        const currentPath = window.location.pathname;
        
        console.log("=== Language Switcher Debug ===");
        console.log("Target language:", language);
        console.log("Current pathname:", currentPath);
        
        // Check if already in target language
        if (language === 'zh-hans' && LanguageUtils.isZhHans(currentPath)) {
            console.log("Already in zh-hans, no action needed");
            return;
        }
        
        if (language === 'zh-hant' && !LanguageUtils.isZhHans(currentPath)) {
            console.log("Not in zh-hans, no action needed");
            return;
        }
        
        // Transform URL based on target language
        let newPathname;
        if (language === 'zh-hans') {
            newPathname = UrlTransformers.toZhHans(currentPath);
        } else {
            newPathname = UrlTransformers.fromZhHans(currentPath);
        }
        
        console.log("Final newPathname:", newPathname);
        console.log("Will redirect:", newPathname !== currentPath);
        
        // Redirect if path changed
        if (newPathname && newPathname !== currentPath) {
            console.log("Redirecting to:", newPathname);
            window.location.pathname = newPathname;
        } else {
            console.log("No redirect needed");
        }
        console.log("=== End Language Switcher Debug ===");
    });

    // Mobile single-char toggle — shows the target language, click to switch
    const mobileLangBtn = document.getElementById('language-switcher-mobile');
    if (mobileLangBtn) {
        const isHans = LanguageUtils.isZhHans(window.location.pathname);
        mobileLangBtn.textContent = isHans ? '繁' : '简';
        mobileLangBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const currentPath = window.location.pathname;
            const newPath = LanguageUtils.isZhHans(currentPath)
                ? UrlTransformers.fromZhHans(currentPath)
                : UrlTransformers.toZhHans(currentPath);
            if (newPath && newPath !== currentPath) {
                window.location.pathname = newPath;
            }
        });
    }
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
window.addEventListener('load', () => {
  const CONFIG = {
    portalRootId: 'ghost-portal-root',
	triggerButtonSelector: 'a[href="#/portal"]',
    regexToClean: /贈送|免費|赠送|免费/g,
  };

  const portalRoot = document.getElementById(CONFIG.portalRootId);
  if (!portalRoot) {
    console.warn(`Ghost Portal root (#${CONFIG.portalRootId}) not found.`);
    return;
  }

  // Store the active observer to disconnect it later
  let innerIframeObserver = null;

  // --- Helper: Debounce (Prevents performance hits on rapid DOM changes) ---
  const debounce = (func, wait) => {
    let timeout;
    return (...args) => {
      clearTimeout(timeout);
      timeout = setTimeout(() => func.apply(this, args), wait);
    };
  };

  // --- Logic 1: Hide Branding ---
  const hideBranding = (doc) => {
    const branding = doc.querySelector('.gh-portal-powered');
    if (branding) branding.style.display = 'none';
  };

  // --- Logic 2: Clean Text ---
  const cleanDetailText = (doc) => {
    const details = doc.querySelectorAll('.gh-portal-list-detail p');
    details.forEach((el) => {
      if (CONFIG.regexToClean.test(el.textContent)) {
        el.textContent = el.textContent.replace(CONFIG.regexToClean, '');
      }
    });
  };

  // --- Logic 3: Handle Monthly Benefits Switch ---
  // Store hidden elements in a WeakMap to handle memory automatically
  const hiddenElementsMap = new WeakMap(); 

  const manageMonthlyBenefits = (doc) => {
    const monthlyBtn = doc.querySelector('.gh-portal-btn[data-test-button="switch-monthly"]');
    const isActive = monthlyBtn?.classList.contains('active');
    
    const productCards = doc.querySelectorAll('.gh-portal-product-card');
    if (productCards.length < 1) return;
    
    // Identify the target cards (the last two)
    const targetCards = Array.from(productCards).slice(-2);
  
    targetCards.forEach(card => {
      const benefits = card.querySelectorAll('.gh-portal-product-benefit');
  
      if (isActive && benefits.length > 3) {
        // Hide last 3 benefits for THIS card
        const toHide = Array.from(benefits).slice(-3);
        toHide.forEach(el => {
          el.style.display = 'none';
          hiddenElementsMap.set(el, true);
        });
      } else {
        // Restore benefits for THIS card if we switched back or they were hidden
        benefits.forEach(el => {
          if (hiddenElementsMap.has(el)) {
            el.style.display = ''; 
            hiddenElementsMap.delete(el);
          }
        });
      }
    });
  };

  // --- Master Apply Function ---
  const applyAllFixes = (doc) => {
    if (!doc) return;
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      hideBranding(doc);
      cleanDetailText(doc);
      manageMonthlyBenefits(doc);
    });
  };

  // --- Setup: Observer for the Iframe Content ---
  const attachIframeObserver = (iframe) => {
    try {
      const doc = iframe.contentDocument;
      if (!doc) return;

      // 1. Apply immediately in case content is already there
      applyAllFixes(doc);

      // 2. Disconnect previous observer if exists to prevent duplicates
      if (innerIframeObserver) innerIframeObserver.disconnect();

      // 3. Create a new observer with Debounce
      innerIframeObserver = new MutationObserver(debounce(() => {
        applyAllFixes(doc);
      }, 50)); // Run max once every 50ms

      // 4. Observe the body for ANY change (Ghost uses React, so entire trees swap out)
      innerIframeObserver.observe(doc.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        attributes: true,
        characterData: true
      });
      
      // 5. Ensure iframe is visible (in case previous logic hid it)
      if (iframe.style.display === 'none') {
        iframe.style.display = 'block';
      }

    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Error attaching observer to Ghost iframe:', e);
    }
  };

  // --- Main: Watch the Portal Root for the Iframe ---
  const portalObserver = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
    for (const mutation of mutations) {
      for (const node of mutation.addedNodes) {
        // Check if the added node is the portal wrapper or contains the iframe
        if (node.tagName === 'DIV' || node.tagName === 'IFRAME') {
          const iframe = node.tagName === 'IFRAME' ? node : node.querySelector('iframe');
          
          if (iframe) {
            // Wait for the iframe to actually load its React app
            iframe.addEventListener('load', () => attachIframeObserver(iframe));
            // Fallback: Try immediately in case it's already cached/loaded
            attachIframeObserver(iframe);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });

  // Start watching the root
  portalObserver.observe(portalRoot, { childList: true, subtree: true });

  // --- Optional: Button Trigger ---
  // (The MutationObserver above catches the iframe appearing, but this helps 
  // if the iframe is already in DOM but hidden via CSS)
  const triggerButton = document.querySelector(CONFIG.triggerButtonSelector);
  if (triggerButton) {
    triggerButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
      // Small delay to allow Ghost script to insert/show the iframe
      setTimeout(() => {
        const iframe = portalRoot.querySelector('iframe');
        if (iframe) attachIframeObserver(iframe);
      }, 200);
    });
  }

  // --- Cleanup on Page Leave ---
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => {
    if (innerIframeObserver) innerIframeObserver.disconnect();
    if (portalObserver) portalObserver.disconnect();
  });
});
</script>

  (function () {
    var GIFT_HASH = /^#\/portal\/gift(?:\/|\?|$)/;
    var REDEEM_HASH = /^#\/portal\/gift\/redeem(?:\/|\?|$)/;

    function getGiftHash(href) {
      try {
        var linkUrl = new URL(href, window.location.href);
        var hash = linkUrl.hash;

        if (!GIFT_HASH.test(hash) || REDEEM_HASH.test(hash)) return null;
        return hash;
      } catch (_) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    function getCurrentPageGiftHref(hash) {
      var currentUrl = new URL(window.location.href);
      currentUrl.hash = hash;
      return currentUrl.href;
    }

    function rewriteGiftLink(anchor) {
      if (!anchor || !anchor.getAttribute) return;

      var giftHash = getGiftHash(anchor.getAttribute('href') || '');
      if (!giftHash) return;

      var currentHref = anchor.getAttribute('href') || '';
      var currentPageHref = getCurrentPageGiftHref(giftHash);

      if (currentHref !== currentPageHref) {
        anchor.setAttribute('href', currentPageHref);
      }
    }

    function rewriteGiftLinks(root) {
      if (!root) return;

      if (root.matches && root.matches('a[href]')) {
        rewriteGiftLink(root);
      }

      if (!root.querySelectorAll) return;

      Array.prototype.forEach.call(root.querySelectorAll('a[href]'), rewriteGiftLink);
    }

    // Outpost injects these anchors after the theme has rendered.
    rewriteGiftLinks(document);

    if (window.MutationObserver && document.body) {
      var observer = new window.MutationObserver(function (mutations) {
        mutations.forEach(function (mutation) {
          if (mutation.type === 'attributes') {
            rewriteGiftLink(mutation.target);
            return;
          }

          Array.prototype.forEach.call(mutation.addedNodes, rewriteGiftLinks);
        });
      });

      observer.observe(document.body, {
        attributes: true,
        attributeFilter: ['href'],
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
      });
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
      if (
        event.button !== 0 ||
        event.metaKey ||
        event.ctrlKey ||
        event.shiftKey
      ) {
        return;
      }

      var anchor = event.target && event.target.closest && event.target.closest('a[href]');
      if (!anchor) return;

      var giftHash = getGiftHash(anchor.getAttribute('href') || '');
      if (!giftHash) return;

      // Preserve normal new-tab/new-window behaviour.
      if (anchor.target && anchor.target !== '_self') return;

      var trigger = document.getElementById('portal-gift-trigger');
      if (!trigger) return;

      // Keep the visible link semantically correct for inspection and copy.
      anchor.setAttribute('href', getCurrentPageGiftHref(giftHash));

      // Do not navigate: Portal's data-portal click handler opens the dialog
      // directly and works for Outpost's asynchronously injected anchors.
      event.preventDefault();
      trigger.click();
    });
